# Separate Training Material

This directory is separate from `AUTISM/`. Its contents are not evidence for
the autism paper and must not be presented as a prevention, treatment, or
causal explanation for ASD.

Included source material:

- `iPAP Beginner Program SUMMARY.pdf`
- `iPAP Beginner Program SUMMARY.pdf.txt`

The PDF is the source object. The text file is a reading copy. They are shipped
together for provenance and accessibility.

See `LICENSE_AND_ACCESS.md` for commercial terms. The package-wide CC0 license
does not apply to these two training files.

# Training License And Access

## Separation

This is a separate commercial training item. It is not part of the autism paper
or autism-paper set, and it is not evidence for any autism claim.

## Price

| Licensee | Price |
|---|---:|
| Company | $299 USD |
| Military or military-support organization | $599 USD |

These are the stated publication prices. No payment processor, purchaser
record, account, credential, or license grant is created by this package.

## Rights

`iPAP Beginner Program SUMMARY.pdf` identifies itself as copyright 2024 Bruce
Wright, all rights reserved. It is not released under the root `LICENSE` or
under CC0. Any distribution or use must respect the rights notice in the source
material and the applicable commercial arrangement.

# Package Integrity Finding v1

## Finding

The source archive `4WAY_PUB_20260920.zip`, SHA-256
`d466646964ad06fc51d57608f75cd4e907fa03df006ed477f61beb4c1c898de6`,
contains `kit_r2_snapshot/SHA256SUMS.txt`. That ledger lists:

```text
44f8b9a9a236676bd952c23a8036338909cdb01ee75de69c1df418b1fda603c6  ./code/__pycache__/apnea_burden.cpython-310.pyc
```

The corresponding file is absent from both the extracted source archive and
this working package. The same package's `STRIP.md` says compiled Python cache
files must not ship in an integrity manifest.

## Effect

The r2 snapshot's ledger does not fully verify as delivered: 17 listed files
verify and one listed compiled-cache file is absent. This finding does not
change the bytes or stated provenance of the 17 verified records.

## Disposition

`kit_r2_snapshot/` is retained unchanged as source evidence. The successor
package must use its own hash ledger and must not represent the r2 ledger as a
complete verification of the delivered snapshot.
